project.name: Format Rip ig-Czq5Miosz9u Sakuga Music Video Remix
project.description: Cinematic mood-montage music-video format from ig-Czq5Miosz9u, re-rendered as high-quality sakuga anime: hand-drawn cel animation with strong, expressive character motion. 6 location-distinct shots = 30s. Silent generation; original 30s IG audio (instrumental track) muxed in post via ffmpeg with -shortest.

source.prompt:
STYLE: high-end sakuga anime, hand-drawn cel animation, expressive crisp inked linework, smooth fluid character motion at high frame counts, painted-watercolor backgrounds, deep saturated palette, dramatic rim lighting and lens flares, anime film grain.

FRAMING: vertical 9:16 with the live anime image inside a centered 2.35:1 cinemascope window-box; pure black bars top and bottom of frame at all times.

SCENE: medium close-up inside a moving car at golden-hour sunset. A young Black man with shoulder-length dreadlocks, gold ear-stud, beige zip-up jacket, sits in the driver's seat. His face is bathed in deep orange-red light from the sun setting through the passenger window; the desert landscape blurs past behind him.

MOTION: his dreadlocks sway from the wind through the open window, his jacket creases catch the light as his shoulders shift, his eyes flick to the road and back, his hand rests on the wheel and adjusts grip, breath subtly visible. Fluid sakuga animation: lots of in-between frames, smooth secondary motion in hair and clothing. Camera is locked off, no pan, no zoom — only the character animates within the frame.

SCENE: extreme wide shot of a deserted two-lane road stretching dead-straight to a vanishing point on the horizon. The young Black man with dreadlocks, beige jacket and dark cargo pants, walks slowly along the centerline of the road, small in the frame. Sun blazes orange-red on the horizon directly behind him, casting a long shadow toward the camera. Cracked asphalt, dry grass either side, distant telephone poles.

His dreadlocks swing with each step, the jacket sways at his hips, dust kicks up from his sneakers, heat-haze ripples on the asphalt, distant grass shifts in the breeze. Sakuga-quality walking cycle: full secondary motion, weight transfer feels real. Camera is locked off.
